      "keystrokes": "python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
import os

os.makedirs('/app/work', exist_ok=True)

for name in ['train', 'test']:
    path = f'/app/data/{name}-00000-of-00001.parquet'
    df = pd.read_parquet(path)
    print(f'{name}: shape={df.shape}')
    print(df['label'].value_counts(normalize=True).sort_index())
    out = f'/app/work/{name}.txt'
    with open(out, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        for label, text in zip(df['label'], df['text']):
            text = str(text).replace('\n', ' ').replace('\r', ' ').strip()
            f.write(f'__label__{label} {text}\n')
    print(f'wrote {out}, size={os.path.getsize(out)} bytes')
